newsitem.title: USA: Donnelly sets new electronics venture.
newsitem.headline: Donnelly sets new electronics venture.

text.p: Donnelly Corp said Tuesday it formed a new joint venture, called Donnelly Electronics, to specialize in the design and manufacture of electronic components and sub-assemblies.
The new Flint, Mich.-based company is a joint venture of Donnelly and David Taylor, an electronics industry veteran, who founded Cirtek in the 1980s.
Donnelly now owns 19 percent of the new venture, and has an option to buy up to 27 percent. The company said it could eventually form a "closer relationship" with the new venture over time.
Production is expected to begin in the spring of 1997.
